capabilities.body: OpenAmer plans a task, runs it with real tools — terminal, browser, files, code — and keeps what worked.
capabilities.title: An agent that thinks along

capabilities.body: Conversations, memory and models live on this machine. Nothing is uploaded unless you ask for it.
capabilities.title: Your hardware, your data

capabilities.body: 186 languages, each in the script you actually read. The first screen of the app asks which one.
capabilities.title: Your language, properly

capabilities.body: Skills are saved from the work itself, so everyday tasks get shorter the longer you use it.
capabilities.title: Capability that grows

help: Check that this machine can reach the internet.
Run the setup again — finished steps are not repeated.
If it fails twice, open the logs; the last lines name the step.
failure.lead: No changes were rolled back silently — OpenAmer stops where it stopped, so a second run continues from there.
failure.leadUpdate: OpenAmer is still on the previous version and keeps working. Nothing was half-replaced.
failure.title: Setup didn’t finish

language.lead: The setup continues in the language you choose here. You can change it later in the app.
language.title: Choose your language

progress.lead: One-time setup: OpenAmer is downloading what it needs and configuring this machine. Later launches skip all of it.
progress.leadUpdate: OpenAmer is replacing the previous version. Your sessions, memory and settings stay untouched.
progress.title: Setting up OpenAmer

cards.body: Open the app and describe what you want done. OpenAmer works in the background and reports back.
cards.title: Start with a sentence

cards.body: Settings → Display → Language. 186 locales, switchable at any time.
cards.title: Pick your language

cards.body: Recurring work becomes a skill — next time it takes one command.
cards.title: Let it remember

success.command: or start it later from a terminal:
success.lead: Everything is in place. OpenAmer is now yours — on this machine, in your language.
success.title: OpenAmer is ready
